futureIllustrationDecision.rasterOrVector2dContext: Eligible: use source image or faithful 2D figure tracing, retaining source-specific caption and contradiction notice. New asset would require its own visual/hash review.
futureIllustrationDecision.contextOnlyIcon: Possible later: topology-based 2D figure icon for this source example, preserving paired bays and long KRU/OPU block. Never inherit as a generic category icon.
futureIllustrationDecision.sourceExample3d: Not approved by this review. Partial orthographic evidence could support a constrained later study of documented envelopes, but no full 3D mesh may be certified without a per-part evidence/omission ledger.
futureIllustrationDecision.defaultProduct3d: Not approved; exact execution construction remains unresolved.

contradictionsAndLimits.evidence: Outer heading says 35/10(6); embedded caption says 110-4Н; component rows 1–6 say 110кВ and row 11 says ОРУ-110кВ.
contradictionsAndLimits.resolution: Treat as a source contradiction. Do not silently correct the source or bind the sheet to v001.

contradictionsAndLimits.evidence: Page 54 explicitly lists КТПБ(К)110/35/10(6). Page 56 identifies 2КТПБ(К), scheme 110-4Н, with KRU 6кВ and does not show/identify a 35 kV tertiary stage.
contradictionsAndLimits.resolution: Related 110 kV source context is defensible; exact 110/35/10(6) construction mapping is not.

contradictionsAndLimits.evidence: Two transformers are specific to the captioned 2КТПБ(К) example. Broad KTPB family comprises configurations.
contradictionsAndLimits.resolution: Do not assert that all family records have two transformers or add new saleable products for the example.

contradictionsAndLimits.evidence: Page 59 contains 110(220) electrical schematics; no 220 kV spatial general arrangement appears in the inspected pp54–59.
contradictionsAndLimits.resolution: Keep v003 unmapped. Electrical topology does not establish physical form.
